title: Deutscher Fussball-Bund Coffee Cup Football Mug Ceramic Coffee Soccer Shape
descriptionText:
Small chip at the top. See pictures. 

Enjoy your morning coffee in style with this unique Deutscher Fussball-Bund coffee mug. The mug is designed in the shape of a soccer ball and features a colorful design with the Bundesfußball logo. It's perfect for all occasions, whether you're watching the game or just relaxing at home.

Made from high-quality ceramic and porcelain materials, this coffee mug is durable and long-lasting. It's easy to clean and maintain, ensuring that you can enjoy your favorite beverage for years to come. Add this collectible mug to your kitchen or dining room today and show off your love for soccer and the Deutscher Fussball-Bund.
